verdict.rationale: Fathom's docs say AI summaries are available instantly after each call and that action items are AI-generated, with advanced and custom summaries on higher tiers. Summaries and action items can also be pushed via webhook or fetched through the get-summary endpoint, which covers the core of a post-meeting summary with next steps. Missing for 10: documentation of the summary's structure (explicit key-points and decisions sections), evidence the output is share-ready without editing, and independent or hands-on corroboration of summary quality.
